description: Read a tender or project document's text into its cables (built and checked by the rules), the required / offered schedule, requirements, conflicts and missing sections, with pages. An LLM (Claude) copies values, deciding nothing. Waits up to about two minutes, then answers a poll link (GET /api/v1/tender/{job}); a PDF: POST /api/v1/tender. Notes: thecablecode://guide/read_tender. Always paid: $4.00 up to 20 pages, $2.00 for each further 10 pages begun, up to 80 pages, USDC (x402).

hint.description: A cable tag or a voltage to look for first.

lang.description: The language of the schedule's parameter names: any of the site's 15 (en, tr, de, nl, sv, fr, es, da, no, fi, it, ro, pl, cs, ru). Default en.

text.description: The document's text (a Word file turned into text); it counts one page per 1,700 characters begun.

name: read_tender
title: Read a tender document: cables built, requirements, schedule, conflicts and gaps
